verdict.rationale: Bulk triage is a fair axis for an email service, but the pack contains no evidence that Fastmail's interface lets users multi-select conversations and archive, label, or mark them done in one action. The keyboard-shortcuts and "Achieve inbox zero" items are bare titles with no content. JMAP's batched methodCalls is a developer building block, not the user-facing capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
